title: Promotion without a paper soak when execution mechanics are already proven (mechanics_proven; one small trade for new mechanics)
note: roadmap L-LADDER. Operator directive 2026-11-01 ~07:55Z (chat to Manager Session 2026-11-01a), VERBATIM: "I also want us to, in general, we need to sort of update the process for promotion. Like, not everything really needs to be soaked, because if the whole idea is that we're basing the decisions off of the quality of the testing, and we're not using the soaking for performance, which we're not, and we shouldn't be, then, like, we don't need to prove everything on, a mechanical soak. If it's not using a new training mechanism, then there's no reason, like, if it needs to, it can also be tested on, one very small trade, just to make sure that everything works end-to-end, and then, it doesn't need to keep on soaking in paper. If it proved itself on the back test and the mechanics are proven, for that, paper and real money are the same, so we can do, fake trade on paper money just to test the mechanics and then move it to real money. There's no reason why we need to, watch it trade on paper first if we're confident enough in the results, and that is the pipeline here, right? Good testing results, and then we're not, testing things in a real simulation for weeks on end, because we just don't have that amount of time for the kind of data that we're generating." Landing HOLD (Tier 3): manager brings it to the operator for the final yes. Done when: merged AND the first mechanics_proven promotion is observed firing MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 without a soak contract.
